armies_of_renown.name: Grundstok Expeditionary Force
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Kharadron Overlords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Grundstok Expeditionary Force Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Kharadron Overlords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the EXPEDITIONARY FORCE keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Arkanaut Admiral
Grundstok Thunderers
Grundstok Gunhauler
Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
Aether-Khemist
Codewright
Aetheric Navigator
Endrinmaster with Endrinharness
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Transport Skyfarers
battle_traits.timing: Your Movement Phase, Reaction: You declared a non-CHARGE MOVE ability for a friendly SKYVESSEL
battle_traits.effect:
Pick a number of units up to that SKYVESSEL's Transport Capacity (see its warscroll) that are wholly within 6" of it to be the targets. Units that have been transported this turn cannot be targets.
Remove the targets from the battlefield. After the SKYVESSEL ends its move, you must set up each target unit on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that SKYVESSEL and not in combat. Those units have been transported. A unit cannot use CHARGE abilities if it was transported in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Gun Butt Low Blow
battle_traits.effect: While a friendly EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY unit is contesting an objective that you control, its melee weapons have Crit (Mortal).

battle_traits.name: No Safe Haven
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Subtract 1 from the control score of that unit for each damage point allocated to it this turn by a shooting attack made by a friendly EXPEDITIONARY FORCE unit, to a maximum of 10 damage points.

battle_traits.name: Grudgefire Rounds
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly EXPEDITIONARY FORCE INFANTRY unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, pick 1 of the target's ranged weapons. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of that weapon for the rest of the phase.

entries.name: Entrenchment Expert
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'All-Out Defence' command for a friendly unit wholly within 12" of this HERO
entries.effect: That friendly unit has WARD (5+) for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Aetheric Nullifier
entries.timing: Opponent declared a SHOOT or FIGHT ability for a MANIFESTATION within 9" of the bearer
entries.effect: Roll 2D6. If the roll equals or exceeds the banishment value listed on the MANIFESTATION's warscroll, it is banished and removed from play. You cannot pick the same MANIFESTATION to be the target of this ability more than once per phase.

armies_of_renown.name: Pioneer Outpost
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Kharadron Overlords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Pioneer Outpost Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Kharadron Overlords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the PIONEER keyword.
Designer’s Note: This Army of Renown has rules designed to work with the Zontari Endrin Dock, so it makes sense to include one on your army roster!
ROSTER OPTIONS
Arkanaut Admiral
Aetheric Navigator
Endrinmaster with Endrinharness
Any non- HERO KHARADRON OVERLORDS INFANTRY units
Grundstok Gunhauler
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Initial Investment
battle_traits.effect: Each friendly AUTO-ENDRIN can move 2D6" but cannot finish that move in combat.

battle_traits.name: Aggressive Acquisitions
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not use any CODE abilities this turn and if there is a friendly PIONEER unit in each large quarter of the battlefield. Each of those units must b e more than 6" from all other large quarters of the battlefield and not in combat.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, enemy units cannot be set up within your territory or within 9" of an objective that you control.

battle_traits.name: Secure Investments
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not use any CODE abilities this turn and if any enemy units that were within 3" of your Zontari Endrin Dock this turn were destroyed this turn.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, ignore the Rend characteristic of combat attacks that target friendly non-INFANTRY PIONEER units or friendly faction terrain features.

battle_traits.name: Settling Accounts
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not use any CODE abilities this turn and if a friendly AUTO-ENDRIN was destroyed this turn by an enemy unit.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time a friendly AUTO-ENDRIN is removed from the battlefield, before removing it, inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit within 3" of that AUTO-ENDRIN

battle_traits.name: Market Dominance
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not use any CODE abilities this turn and if you control every objective that is not wholly within enemy territory.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, each time you use your Zontari Endrin Dock's 'Endrinworks Outpost' ability, you can set up a replacement AUTO-ENDRIN on a manufacturing roll of 3+ instead of 4+.

battle_traits.name: Hostile Takeover
battle_traits.declare: You can only use this ability if you have not use any CODE abilities this turn and if an enemy HERO was destroyed by shooting attacks made by a friendly PIONEER unit this turn.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the battle, subtract 1 from hit rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly PIONEER units or friendly faction terrain features.

entries.name: Territorial Trailblazer
entries.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are in combat with this unit.

entries.name: Copper Fingers
entries.timing: Reaction: You declared the 'Endrinworks Outpost' ability for a Zontari Endrin Dock
entries.effect: If this unit is wholly within 9" of that Zontari Endrin Dock, instead of resolving the effect of that 'Endrinworks Outpost' ability, set up a replacement AUTO-ENDRIN on the battlefield, wholly within 6" of that Zontari Endrin Dock and more than 3" from all enemy units.

entries.name: Thorgsson's Universal Automaton Actuator
entries.effect: Add 6" to the Move characteristic of friendly AUTO-ENDRINS while they are wholly within 6" of this unit.

entries.name: Rockbuster Charges
entries.declare: Pick a terrain feature that this unit passed across this turn. Each enemy unit within 1" of that terrain feature is a target.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each target.

armies_of_renown.name: The Duardin Ascendant
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Fyreslayers, Kharadron Overlords or Cities of Sigmar faction for your army, you can choose it to be a Duardin Ascendant Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Fyreslayers, Kharadron Overlords or Cities of Sigmar faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the organisation below. All units in your army gain the DUARDIN ASCENDANT keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Grombrindal (must be include and must be your general}
Any ORDER DUARDIN unit
REGIMENT OPTIONS
You cannot include Regiments of Renown
You cannot include MANIFESTATIONS
You cannot include faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Duardrazhal
battle_traits.effect: Friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units are unified while they are wholly within 12" of at least 1 FYRESLAYERS, 1 KHARADRON OVERLORDS, and 1 CITIES OF SIGMAR DUARDIN unit.

battle_traits.name: 'As the Ancestors Intended!'
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to chanting rolls for the target for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: 'Pah! Now This Is a Shot...'
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's ranged weapons for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: 'As One, Kinfolk!'
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 3 friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY units to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, add 1 to the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the targets, to a maximum of 3.

battle_traits.name: 'Settle Every Grudge! Khazuk!'
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly unified DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of the target's melee weapons for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Tireless Purpose
entries.effect: Each time a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Normal Move' ability, add 2" to the distance that unit can move as part of that ability.

entries.name: Valayan Hearth-banner
entries.declare: Pick each friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit on the battlefield to be the targets.

entries.name: Spirit of the White Dwarf
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT unit within 18" of them to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: The target is unified until the start of your next turn. If the chanting roll was 8+, you can pick 2 targets instead of 1.

entries.name: Oath of Restoration
entries.declare: Pick a friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT PRIEST to chant this prayer, pick a visible objective within 18" of them that is coned by 2 or more friendly unified units to be the target, then make a chanting roll of D6.
entries.effect: Until the start of your next turn, friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT units have WARD (6+) while they have any models contesting the target. If the chanting roll was 7+, friendly DUARDIN ASCENDANT models have WARD (5+) while they have any models contesting the target instead.

armies_of_renown.name: The Magnate's Crew
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Kharadron Overlords faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a The Magnate’s Crew Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules in this section instead of the Kharadron Overlords faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the MAGNATE’S CREW keyword.
If your army does not include Brokk Grungsson, you can pick an Arkanaut Ironclad in your army to be your general instead of a HERO. If you do, that Arkanaut Ironclad gains the HERO keyword. It cannot be included in another HERO’s regiment but gains the following Regiment Options: Any MAGNATE’S CREW units
ROSTER OPTIONS
Brokk Grungsson, Lord-Magnate of Barak-Nar
Endrinmaster with Dirigible Suit
Null-Khemist
Arkanaut Ironclad
Arkanaut Frigate
Grundstok Gunhauler
Vongrim Salvagers
Vongrim Harpoon Crew
Skywardens
Endrinriggers
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Loyalty to the Magnate
battle_traits.effect: While a friendly Brokk Grungsson is wholly within the combat range of another friendly MAGNATE'S CREW INFANTRY unit, both those units have WARD (5+)

battle_traits.name: Pay Your Debts
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit on the battlefield or in reserve to be indebted.
battle_traits.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for combat attacks made by friendly MAGNATE'S CREW units that target the indebted unit.

battle_traits.name: Bold Moves
battle_traits.declare: Pick any number of friendly MAGNATE'S CREW INFANTRY units that are in combat to be the targets. Make an emergency launch roll of 3D6 for each target.
battle_traits.effect:
Each target can move a distance up to the value of its emergency launch roll. It can move through the combat ranges of any enemy units but cannot end that move in combat with an enemy unit that it was not in combat with at the start of the phase.
The target(s) cannot use CHARGE abilities for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Cutting-Edge Endrinpacks
battle_traits.declare: Pick up to 2 friendly MAGNATE'S CREW INFANTRY units that are wholly within 9" of a friendly MAGNATE'S CREW SKYVESSEL to be the targets.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, each target can use CHARGE abilities even if it used a RUN ability in the same turn.

battle_traits.name: Invictunite-lined Hull
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly MAGNATE'S CREW SKYVESSEL to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Roll a D3. For the rest of the turn, subtract X from the Rend characteristic of weapons used for attacks that target that SKYVESSEL, where X is equal to the roll.

battle_traits.name: Constant Barrage
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy unit that had any damage points allocated to it this phase by a friendly MAGNATE'S CREW unit's attacks to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Until the start of your next turn, each time the target ends a move within 10" of any friendly MAGNATE'S CREW units, roll a D3. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on the target equal to the roll.

entries.name: Master of Discipline
entries.effect: Each time a friendly MAGNATE'S CREW INFANTRY unit wholly within 12" of this unit uses the 'Redeploy' command, you can re-roll the dice.

entries.name: Flanking Fire
entries.effect: Add 1 to hit rolls for shooting attacks made by friendly MAGNATE'S CREW SKYVESSELS that target an enemy unit in combat with this unit.

entries.name: Aerodynamism
entries.effect: If the unit moved this turn, subtract 1 from hit rolls for attacks that target this unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Guns for All Occasions
entries.declare: Pick an enemy unit in combat with this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on the target.
